'''February 2000 New York City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in New York City, NY on 13 February 2000. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d253">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 February 2000
* '''Site:''' New York City, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 73
